topic.title: Creating a Review Task
topic.shortdesc: Introductory information about creating a review task and choosing the task type that matches your content and workflow.

body.p: supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks.
Choose the task type based on where the content is managed and how you plan to handle the review results.

ul.li: Project Review Tasks are for content that is already managed in an project. They support a project-based workflow that includes integrating accepted changes back into the project.
Independent Review Tasks are for content that is not tied to a project. They are useful when you want to review standalone content or start a review outside a project workflow.

body.p: Only users with the Author platform user role can create Project Review Tasks. Any user with either the Author platform user role or Subject-Matter Expert platform user role can create Independent Review Tasks.
